# netcup_server_snapshot (Data Source)

One snapshot of a netcup server (SCP REST API). `netcup_server_snapshot_download` has the download of an exported one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_snapshot" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
  name      = "before-upgrade"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot.
- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) Time of the snapshot.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `disks` (List of String) Disks of the snapshot.
- `exported` (Boolean) Whether it was exported.
- `exported_size_in_kib` (Number) Size of the export in KiB.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether it is an online snapshot.
- `state` (String) Power state in the snapshot.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the snapshot.
